# Ohm's law
Voltage across a resistor equals current times resistance, V = IR. Resistance is measured in ohms.

# Series resistors
Resistors in series carry the same current; the equivalent resistance is the sum R = R1 + R2 + R3.

# Parallel resistors
Resistors in parallel share the same voltage; 1/R = 1/R1 + 1/R2. Two equal resistors in parallel give half the resistance.

# Power
Electrical power P = VI = I^2 R = V^2 / R, measured in watts.

# First law
An object stays at rest or in uniform motion unless acted on by a net external force. This property is inertia.

# Second law
Net force equals mass times acceleration, F = ma. Force is measured in newtons.

# Third law
For every action there is an equal and opposite reaction; the forces act on different bodies.
